messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — smart-routing detected repeated region health flips across 3 regions. probed paths: us-east -> eu -> us-west -> us-east. routing fallback loop forming. auto-escalation to on-call.

maya_oncall: On it. paging ops now. any customer-facing impact yet?

rajat: seeing ~12% increased 503s on requests routed across regions. ttfb spikes when fallback kicks in. timeline: 3031229800-first minor probe failure, repeated every ~18s.

clara: logs show health-probe heartbeat toggling:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:23Z probe_us_east: OK
2026-03-15T10:12:41Z probe_eu: FAIL (latency threshold)
2026-03-15T10:12:58Z probe_us_west: OK
2026-03-15T10:13:05Z probe_us_east: FAIL (kv-cache latency)
```
looks like two regions report marginal latency and the routing policy immediately cascades fallback to next region, which then flips back — a helix-like rotation.

sre-lead: this is the classic short-debounce + immediate-fallback combination. we should disable cross-region fallthrough while we stabilize. maya, can you apply rollback to routing policy v4 and add a 60s cooldown?

maya_oncall: Applying now. running: 
```
curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/active" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"fallback_enabled":false,"cooldown_secs":60}'
```

maya_oncall: PATCH done. policy now points to v4-stable. fallback disabled. waiting for propagation (2–3s).

rajat: telemetry after change: tailing 30s: 503s down to baseline, cross-region traffic reduced by 78%. however, a subset of requests still hit variant mismatch (wrong-model-variant) because earlier rollouts used eu-quantized variant in us-west.

clara: we'll need a quick kill-switch for model-variant routing too. propose: set model-variant affinity to "region-local" for 10m and queue a stratified rollout to correct quantization mismatch. config snippet: 
```
{ "model_affinity": "region-local", "max_variants": 1, "enforce_compatibility": true }
```

sre-lead: maya, please apply model-affinity override and increase probe debounce to 12s. also enable circuit-breaker for cross-region calls at 5% error rate.

maya_oncall: Doing three ops: 1) model-affinity override, 2) probe debounce bump, 3) circuit-breaker ON.
```
# 1
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides" -d '{"model_affinity":"region-local","ttl_secs":600}'
# 2
curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/config/probes" -d '{"debounce_ms":12000}'
# 3
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/circuit_breakers" -d '{"scope":"cross-region","error_rate":0.05}'
```

maya_oncall: Overrides applied. circuit-breaker tripped for a short window as expected then recovered. probe debounce change rolled out to 3 control-plane nodes.

rajat: post-mitigation metrics (next 3m): 503s back to baseline, latency p95 improved from 620ms -> 230ms, cross-region bounce count down to single-digit.

support-team: Customer impact assessment: ~70 customers experienced transient degraded responses for ~6–12 minutes during the initial flare. No data loss. Creating status page update draft and CS outreach for top 10 impacted customers.

clara: root cause hypothesis: health probe sensitivity + immediate fallthrough rule + small regional latency bump (KV cache GC in eu) triggered a rotation in fallback which then re-marked previous region as unhealthy and caused loop. Also a recent model rollout left an incompatible quantized variant in one region.

sre-lead: temporary mitigations applied = disable cross-region fallback, model-affinity region-local override, debounce increase, circuit-breaker. Next steps: 1) revert temporary overrides only after 24h of stable telemetry; 2) fix probe threshold to use composite signals (latency+error+kv-oom) not single probe; 3) coordinate with model-onboarding to remove incompatible variance; 4) postmortem owner: rajat.

maya_oncall: paging clear for ops. marking incident as acknowledged -> mitigated. stamping follow-up meeting at 11:00 UTC with SRE, ML infra, and routing engineers.

incident-bot: Incident runbook update suggested: add 30s minimum cooldown to any cross-region fallback + enable model-variant compatibility gates in routing decision.

clara: adding notes to the incident doc and will start the evaluation tests for model-variant compatibility harness.

support-team: status-page published: "Partial degradation for a subset of customers between 10:12–10:20 UTC; mitigated. Root cause analysis in progress."

maya_oncall: TL;DR: Helix fallback loop between us-east/eu/us-west caused transient 503s. mitigated by disabling cross-region fallthrough, enforcing region-local model affinity, increasing probe debounce, and adding circuit-breaker. owner: rajat (postmortem).

sre-lead: :thumbsup:. closing live triage. will escalate to SEV2 postmortem.

clara: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and timeline attachments.
